stem.text: A ball rolls in a straight line up a ramp and then back down the ramp along its original path.
Which graph shows the variation with time of the ball's velocity?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled velocity and horizontal axis labelled time; a straight line starts above the origin, slopes downward and crosses the time axis.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled velocity and horizontal axis labelled time; a line rises from the origin to a peak and then falls to the time axis.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled velocity and horizontal axis labelled time; a line rises from the origin, drops vertically with a dashed line, then rises again to the time axis.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled velocity and horizontal axis labelled time; a line falls from above the origin to the time axis, then rises again.
